author: Ari Koslow
title: Graham Pauley optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Marlins optioned Graham Pauley to Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Pauley returns to Triple-A with Liam Hicks activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Bender (shin) placed on IL
desc: The Marlins placed Anthony Bender on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Bender is dealing with a right shin stress reaction. He will be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zach Brzykcy recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Marlins recalled Zach Brzykcy from Triple-A Jacksonville.
impact: Brzykcy returns in a middle-relief role in the Marlins bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Liam Hicks (back) activated from IL
desc: The Marlins activated Liam Hicks from the injured list.
impact: Hicks makes his return on the day he is first eligible on Tuesday. Graham Pauley was optioned as the corresponding move.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Stephen Kolek transferred to family medical emergency list
desc: Royals right-hander Stephen Kolek has been transferred to the Family Medical Emergency List.
impact: Kolek was placed on the paternity list on June 26 and will now miss some additional time. He owns a 4.15 ERA through nine starts this season, although his nine runs allowed in 1 2/3 innings his last time out have greatly skewed those numbers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Sogard (oblique) to begin rehab assignment Thursday
desc: Nick Sogard will go on a rehab assignment starting on Thursday.
impact: It remains unclear if Sogard will begin his rehab assignment in Double-A or Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Juan Burgos optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks optioned Juan Burgos to Triple-A.
impact: Burgos returns to Triple-A to make room for Brandon Pfaadt.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Pfaadt recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Diamondbacks recalled Brandon Pfaadt from Triple-A.
impact: Pfaadt will take the mound for Tuesday's game against the Giants. It is unclear how long he will go on the mound.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Greene (elbow) to be activated Saturday
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Hunter Greene will return from the injured list on Saturday.
impact: Greene will be activated on Saturday. He shouldn't be facing any pitch count or restriction.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitchell Parker to likely need Tommy John surgery
desc: Nationals manager Blake Butera said Mitchell Parker will most likely need Tommy John surgery.
impact: Parker was diagnosed with a Grade 3 UCL sprain. There should be confirmation soon.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Fried (elbow) to throw live BP again Sunday
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Max Fried will throw live batting practice again on Sunday.
impact: Fried threw a successful session of live BP on Tuesday. If all goes well on Sunday, he could soon be cleared to begin a rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Graham Ashcraft (elbow) to be cleared to resume throwing soon
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Graham Ashcraft got good news and is expected to be cleared to resume throwing soon.
impact: Ashcraft received a follow-up MRI on Tuesday. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yandy Diaz (shoulder) back in lineup Tuesday
desc: Yandy Diaz is back in the Rays lineup on Tuesday against the Royals.
impact: Diaz had left Sunday's game against the Diamondbacks due to a left shoulder strain. He is back leading off as the designated hitter.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremy Pena (calf) expects to have short stint on IL
desc: Jeremy Pena told reporters he is not expected to miss much time.
impact: Pena was officially placed on the injured list on Tuesday. He said he had been playing through left calf pain for "a week, week and a half" and it gradually got worse.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ronald Acuna Jr. (hamstring) unlikely to return before All-Star break
desc: Braves manager Walt Weiss said it's a "long shot" that Ronald Acuna Jr. will be back before the All-Star break
impact: Acuna went through a full workout on the field on Tuesday. He will likely be sidelined into August.
